# myfill { #wass2s.myfill }

```python
myfill(all_model_fcst, obs)
```

Fill missing values in forecast data using random samples from observations.

This function fills NaN values in the forecast data by randomly sampling values from the observed 
rainfall data along the time dimension.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type             | Description                                                                | Default    |
|----------------|------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| all_model_fcst | xarray.DataArray | Forecast data with dimensions (T, M, Y, X) containing possible NaN values. | _required_ |
| obs            | xarray.DataArray | Observed rainfall data with dimensions (T, Y, X) used for filling NaNs.    | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name             | Type             | Description                                                                  |
|------------------|------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| da_filled_random | xarray.DataArray | Forecast data with NaN values filled using random samples from observations. |
